title: Trust & Business Identity Re-Verification
methodology: Re-checked every trust surface directly against the live site, not inherited from AQ-06C's findings. No redesign performed — per the ticket, only documented if a genuine new deficiency was found; none was.

about.evidence: Substantive, specific methodology explanation; names the operating entity (Albor Digital LLC, Wyoming); visible contact email.

contact.evidence: No dedicated /contact page, but a real, visible, working mailto link on both homepage and About page, plus a structured ContactPoint in Organization schema. Same assessment as AQ-06C: satisfies the substance of a contact requirement.

business_identity.evidence: Albor Digital LLC / Wyoming / US consistently represented across Organization schema, About, and all 4 legal pages — re-verified directly this pass, not assumed.

ownership_transparency.evidence: No shell-entity or anonymous-ownership signals anywhere checked.

privacy.dates: Effective Date: January 1, 2026, Last Updated: January 1, 2026

terms.dates: Effective Date: January 1, 2026, Last Updated: January 1, 2026

legal_documents.date_consistency: All 4 legal pages carry the same effective date, internally consistent, no stale-looking mismatch.

responsible_ai_disclosure.evidence: disclaimer.html §3 AI-Generated Content clause re-confirmed present and substantive — still an above-average trust signal for a site this size.

food_safety_allergen_disclaimer.evidence: No allergen/food-safety-specific language found in disclaimer.html. Same STILL OPEN, low-severity, non-policy finding as AQ-06C.

consistency_between_legal_identity_and_p.evidence: Business name, jurisdiction, and contact channel match exactly across Organization schema (index.html, about.html), the About page's prose, and all 4 legal pages' 'operated by Albor Digital LLC' framing. No discrepancy found.

named_author_visibility.evidence: The homepage FAQ's specific authorship claim ('Content is authored by Gustavo Aragones...') remains present only in JSON-LD, absent from visible rendered text. Re-confirmed directly this pass. Not touched by AQ-07 or AQ-06R2 (outside their scope — narrative/template content, not homepage static content).

overall_assessment: Trust infrastructure remains fundamentally sound, re-verified directly rather than assumed unchanged. No new deficiency found. The 2 pre-existing findings (named-author visibility, no food-safety disclaimer) are unchanged, correctly carried forward as STILL OPEN in the baseline comparison, neither a policy violation.
